item.text: I’ve checked all 140 items against the six templates. The revision queries cover both `REVISED_TO` and reverse `IS_REVISION_OF` links. I’m now checking the generated text for allowed clauses and column order before writing the file.

item.command:
/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re,collections
from pathlib import Path

packet=json.loads(Path('packet.json').read_text())
items=packet['items']
assert len(items)==140
assert len({item['id'] for item in items})==140

def literal(value):
    return \"'\"+value.replace('\\\\','\\\\\\\\').replace(\"'\",\"\\\\'\")+\"'\"

patterns={
 'decision_pack': r'Change request (R3-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS (\\d+\\.\\d+)\\) was handled by RAN3\\. What source-verified disposition did RAN3 record for the whole document and at which RAN3 meeting, and in which TSG RAN CR pack was it then submitted\\? Give the disposition, the RAN3 meeting, the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting\\.',
 'pack_lookup': r'In which TSG RAN CR pack was change request (R3-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS (\\d+\\.\\d+)\\) submitted\\? Give the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting\\.',
 'revisions': r'RAN3 recorded document (R3-\\d+) as revised\\. Follow its revisions to every later version that has a source-verified RAN3 disposition for the whole document and was submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack\\. Give each such document, that disposition, and the CR pack document number\\.',
 'release_clause': r'Which (Rel-\\d+) change requests that modify clause (\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)*) of TS (\\d+\\.\\d+) have a source-verified RAN3 disposition for the whole document and were submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack\\? Give each document, its disposition, the RAN3 meeting, and the CR pack document number\\.',
 'trace_clauses': r'Trace change request (R3-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS (\\d+\\.\\d+)\\) from the RAN3 decision to the clauses it modifies\\. Give the source-verified disposition RAN3 recorded for the whole document, the RAN3 meeting, the TSG RAN CR pack document number, the TSG RAN meeting, and each clause of TS (\\d+\\.\\d+) that the CR modifies\\.',
 'pack_contents': r'TSG RAN CR pack (RP-\\d+) carries change requests from RAN3\\. For each change request in the pack that has a source-verified RAN3 disposition for the whole document, give the document, the disposition, and the RAN3 meeting\\.'
}

expected_fields={
 'decision_pack':['disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack','tsg_meeting'],
 'pack_lookup':['cr_pack','tsg_meeting'],
 'revisions':['final_document','disposition','cr_pack'],
 'release_clause':['document','disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack'],
 'trace_clauses':['disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack','tsg_meeting','clause'],
 'pack_contents':['document','disposition','wg_meeting']
}

decision_match='''MATCH (resolution:Resolution)-[:HAS_DISPOSITION]->(decision:DecisionDisposition)-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(document)
MATCH (resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(meeting:Meeting)
WHERE decision.evidenceStatus = 'source_verified'
  AND resolution.resolutionScope = 'document_disposition'
  AND meeting.workingGroup = 'RAN3' '''.rstrip()

expressions={
 'disposition':'decision.dispositionCode',
 'wg_meeting':'meeting.meetingNumber',
 'cr_pack':'pack.crPackId',
 'tsg_meeting':'pack.tsgMeeting',
 'document':'document.tdocNumber',
 'final_document':'document.tdocNumber',
 'clause':'section.sectionNumber'
}

rows=[]
counts=collections.Counter()
examples={}
for item in items:
    matches=[(name,re.fullmatch(pattern,item['question'])) for name,pattern in patterns.items()]
    matches=[(name,match) for name,match in matches if match]
    assert len(matches)==1, (item['id'],'unrecognized or overlapping wording')
    name,match=matches[0]
    args=match.groups()
    assert item['fields']==expected_fields[name], (item['id'],'field mismatch')
    if name=='pack_lookup':
        head=f'MATCH (document:Tdoc {{tdocNumber: {literal(args[0])}}})-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(pack:CRPack)'
    elif name=='decision_pack':
        head=f'MATCH (document:Tdoc {{tdocNumber: {literal(args[0])}}})-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(pack:CRPack)\\n'+decision_match
    elif name=='pack_contents':
        head=f'MATCH (document:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(pack:CRPack {{crPackId: {literal(args[0])}}})\\n'+decision_match
    elif name=='release_clause':
        release,clause,spec=args
        head=(f'MATCH (document:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(:Release {{releaseName: {literal(release)}}})\\n'
              f'MATCH (document)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(section:Section {{specNumber: {literal(spec)}, sectionNumber: {literal(clause)}}})\\n'
              'MATCH (document)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(pack:CRPack)\\n'+decision_match)
    elif name=='trace_clauses':
        doc,cr,spec,repeated_spec=args
        assert spec==repeated_spec
        head=(f'MATCH (document:Tdoc {{tdocNumber: {literal(doc)}}})-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(pack:CRPack)\\n'
              f'MATCH (document)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(section:Section {{specNumber: {literal(spec)}}})\\n'+decision_match)
    elif name=='revisions':
        head=(f'MATCH revisionPath = (original:Tdoc {{tdocNumber: {literal(args[0])}}})-[:REVISED_TO|IS_REVISION_OF*1..]-(document:Tdoc)\\n'
              'WHERE document <> original\\n'
              '  AND all(i IN range(0, length(revisionPath) - 1) WHERE\\n'
              \"    (type(relationships(revisionPath)[i]) = 'REVISED_TO'\\n\"
              '      AND startNode(relationships(revisionPath)[i]) = nodes(revisionPath)[i])\\n'
              \"    OR (type(relationships(revisionPath)[i]) = 'IS_REVISION_OF'\\n\"
              '      AND endNode(relationships(revisionPath)[i]) = nodes(revisionPath)[i]))\\n'
              'WITH DISTINCT document\\n'
              'MATCH (document)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(pack:CRPack)\\n'+decision_match)
    query=head+'\\nRETURN DISTINCT '+', '.join(expressions[field]+' AS '+field for field in item['fields'])
    returned=query.rsplit('RETURN DISTINCT ',1)[1]
    assert [part.split(' AS ')[1] for part in returned.split(', ')]==item['fields']
    assert query.count('RETURN DISTINCT ')==1
    stripped=re.sub(r\"'(?:\\\\.|["'^'"'\\\\])*'\", \"''\", query)
    assert not re.search(r'\\b(CREATE|MERGE|DELETE|DETACH|SET|REMOVE|DROP|CALL|LOAD|FOREACH|UNWIND|UNION|OPTIONAL|ORDER|LIMIT|SKIP|USE|SHOW)\\b',stripped)
    clause_starts=re.findall(r'"'^(MATCH|WHERE|WITH|RETURN)'"\\b',query,re.M)
    assert clause_starts[0]=='MATCH' and clause_starts[-1]=='RETURN'
    rows.append({'id':item['id'],'cypher':query})
    counts[name]+=1
    examples.setdefault(name,query)

# Validate the generated text in memory, without opening any output or running Cypher.
schema=packet['task'].split('Stored value domains,',1)[0]
labels=set(re.findall(r'\\(:([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*)',schema))
relations=set(re.findall(r'\\[:([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\\]',schema))
for row in rows:
    query=row['cypher']
    for bracket in re.findall(r'\\[(["'^'"\\]]*)\\]',query):
        if bracket.startswith(':'):
            names=bracket[1:].split('*',1)[0].split('|')
            assert set(names)<=relations,(row['id'],names)
    used_labels=set(re.findall(r'\\([A-Za-z]*:([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*)',query))
    assert used_labels<=labels
    assert '<ns>' not in query
shapes={re.sub(r\"'(?:\\\\.|["'^'"'\\\\])*'\", \"'?'\",row['cypher']) for row in rows}
assert len(shapes)==6
serialized=''.join(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False)+'\\n' for row in rows)
roundtrip=[json.loads(line) for line in serialized.splitlines()]
assert roundtrip==rows
assert [row['id'] for row in rows]==[item['id'] for item in items]
assert all(set(row)=={'id','cypher'} for row in rows)
Path('queries.jsonl').write_text(serialized,encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'queries_written':len(rows),'distinct_query_shapes':len(shapes),'pattern_counts':dict(counts),'record_selection_ambiguities':[]},ensure_ascii=False))
for name,query in examples.items():
    print('\\n'+name+'\\n'+query)
PY"
